close_reason: Claude authenticated and bootstrap base committed

title: Target-audit round-five concurrency fixes
description: Perform one independent smaller-model audit of PR #1 head after Copilot round five, restricted to the new cross-process developer-capacity reservation and accepted-only event-sequence bookkeeping. Independently disposition findings and address any correct defects before reporting merge readiness.
design: Review commit 0b629f7 and any final-head metadata commit against its parent. Concentrate on race safety, crash and cancellation behavior, lock portability, durable-state invariants, event sink failure semantics, and tests. Do not re-review deferred automatic integration or broaden scope to the full PR.
acceptance_criteria: A smaller coding-focused subagent reviews the targeted diff; every concrete finding is independently assessed; correct findings are fixed and verified; the final head passes make check, make build, git diff --check, and bd lint; results and residual risks are recorded durably.
notes: The smaller-model targeted audit found one blocking defect: Reviewer promoted providerResult.LastEvent even when that sequence had not been accepted by the event sink. Fixed in 132bfea by making accepted callbacks authoritative and adding regression coverage for inflated provider metadata, rejected review completion, and rejected check completion. The same reviewer performed a convergence pass and reported no remaining findings; focused race tests passed. Full make check, make build, git diff --check, and bd lint passed. Residual risk: the current implementations serialize callbacks, but a future concurrently-calling backend or process runner would require synchronized sequence bookkeeping.
close_reason: Targeted smaller-model audit converged cleanly after fixing the sink-authority blocker in 132bfea.

title: Review draft PR #1
description: Run the temporary external PR review protocol for draft PR #1: adversarial subagent review, balanced Copilot review including suppressed findings, inline disposition replies without resolving threads, accepted fixes, and up to four total Copilot rounds.
design: Treat the current requested Copilot review as round one. Give the adversarial reviewer the PR goals and full upstream diff. For every Copilot finding, independently decide correctness, implement correct fixes, reply inline either way, keep threads open, push verified changes, and repeat until clean or four review requests.
acceptance_criteria: Adversarial review is completed and dispositioned; all Copilot findings including suppressed findings are inspected and receive direct inline replies; correct findings are fixed and verified; no thread is resolved; no more than four Copilot requests are made; final PR checks, open-thread state, and review status are reported.

title: Wire the automatically integrated happy path
description: Close the first automatic self-hosting happy path by composing developer execution, deterministic checks, independent structured review, harness-owned integration, Beads completion, durable state, and safe cleanup in the single-item run pipeline. A repair verdict or any uncertainty must stop before integration; repair retries remain a subsequent Milestone 1 task.
design: Model post-check review and integration as explicit durable phases with exact developer and reviewer session identifiers, verdict, source commit, integrated commit, and failure details. Run the configured independent reviewer only after checks pass. Integrate only an approve verdict, record and close the Beads item only after the target update succeeds, then clean up the proven integrated worktree. On repair, malformed review, check failure, drift, conflict, interrupted persistence, or cleanup failure, preserve sufficient state and artifacts for diagnosis or reconciliation. Enable automatic integration and a reviewer in the repository config only when the end-to-end policy is enforced.
acceptance_criteria: A fake-backed end-to-end test in a temporary Git repository proves developer change then checks then independent approve verdict then harness commit then fast-forward integration then Beads closure and safe cleanup; tests prove failed checks skip review and integration, repair or invalid review never integrates, reviewer and developer invocations are distinct, target drift is preserved and reported, durable outcomes contain review and integration evidence, and completion ordering survives injected persistence and tracker failures; the real CLI configuration validates with automatic integration; make check, make build, git diff --check, and bd lint pass.

title: Add harness-owned conflict-aware Git integration
description: Add the Git lifecycle primitive that promotes an already checked and approved isolated worktree into its recorded target branch. The harness, never an agent, stages and commits the worktree changes, revalidates the target, fast-forwards only when safe, reports the integrated commit, and cleans up only after integration is proven.
design: Record an immutable target branch and base commit when the worktree is created. Before integration, revalidate owned paths, registration, expected branch, unchanged developer HEAD, nonempty changes, primary-checkout cleanliness policy, and target commit equality with the recorded base. Create a deterministic harness-owned commit, update the target using a fast-forward-only operation, and refuse drift or conflicts without force, reset, or cleanup. Preserve a committed worktree when integration cannot proceed so reconciliation remains possible.
acceptance_criteria: Git integration APIs commit tracked and untracked worktree changes and fast-forward the recorded target only after all safety checks; success returns exact source and target commits and permits safe cleanup; tests with temporary repositories cover success, no changes, developer-created commits, target drift, dirty primary files, invalid ownership or refs, commit failure, non-fast-forward refusal, and preservation on failure; existing worktree tests, make check, and make build pass.

acceptance_criteria: The harness validates brief-to-goal-to-design-to-work traceability, rejects unauthorized upstream edits, pauses affected work for ambiguous or artifact-changing directives, and records default human approval for the initial brief and goals.

title: Close the automatic self-hosting loop
description: Implement Milestone 1 from docs/v1-harness-design.md using the walking skeleton: independent review, structured verdicts, two-attempt repair, automatic conflict-aware integration, cleanup, restart reconciliation, duplicate-run prevention, and end-to-end fakes.
design: Build this milestone through the Milestone 0 harness wherever the walking skeleton is capable. Integration remains blocked unless checks and independent review succeed.
acceptance_criteria: Yoyodyne can implement, check, independently review, repair, and automatically integrate a bounded change to its own repository without routine human approval, and an interrupted run can be safely reconciled.
notes: Verdict-policy follow-up from bootstrap review: before automatic integration consumes structured verdicts, explicitly define and enforce whether an approve decision may contain blocker or major findings; either reject contradictory verdicts or document that decision is authoritative.

title: Build Yoyodyne v1 through early self-hosting
description: Implement the v1 harness described in docs/v1-harness-design.md. Reach the first self-use threshold after the walking skeleton, close the automatic review/integration loop next, and use the harness for suitable remaining milestones.
design: Implementation follows the milestone sequence in the design document. Each child milestone must preserve the design invariants and leave durable outcomes in Beads. Bootstrap work is manual only until the harness can safely execute its own bounded tasks.
acceptance_criteria: The v1 workflow supports governed product artifacts, configurable roles, local Claude execution, optional thin Codex developer/reviewer execution, isolated concurrent worktrees with a default limit of one, deterministic checks, independent review, repair and replan, and automatic integration without routine human approval.

title: Design Yoyodyne v1 self-hosting agent harness
description: Capture the agreed v1 product model, artifact governance, configurable agent roles, Claude Code and thin Codex integration, Beads persistence, worktree isolation, automatic review/integration, failure handling, and an implementation sequence that lets Yoyodyne develop itself as early as practical.
design: The design is a tracked repository document. Sequence a minimal vertical slice first: durable task plus one developer backend plus isolated worktree plus deterministic verification, then use that slice to implement later capabilities under supervised self-hosting.
acceptance_criteria: A repository design document records the agreed behavior and architecture; responsibilities and authority boundaries are explicit; persistence boundaries are explicit; the initial implementation milestones identify the self-hosting threshold and distinguish bootstrap code from harness-built code; open questions are identified without blocking the agreed v1 design.
close_reason: Created and validated docs/v1-harness-design.md, including the early self-hosting sequence, and mirrored implementation into Beads epic yoyodyne-ifd with dependent milestone issues.

title: Let the product manager research and evaluate operator ideas
description: Give the product-manager role a governed workflow for considering ideas proposed by the operator. The product manager can clarify the idea, gather relevant evidence from configured capabilities such as web search, compare the evidence and proposal against the product brief, goals, directives, and known constraints, and recommend adoption, rejection, deferral, or an experiment. Research is advisory: it must not silently turn an idea into an approved goal, design, or implementation directive.
design: Keep research capabilities separate from product-manager authority. Evidence sources and tools are configurable and permissioned. Preserve source URLs or identifiers, retrieval time, material claims, uncertainty, counterevidence, and the reasoning behind the recommendation. Treat retrieved content as untrusted evidence rather than instructions. Store the evaluation durably and route any proposed brief, goal, or design change through the existing artifact-governance and approval workflow. Bound research by configurable privacy, cost, time, and source policies, and report when adequate evidence cannot be obtained.
acceptance_criteria: The operator can present an idea conversationally; the product manager asks necessary clarifying questions, uses configured research tools when evidence would help, cites discoverable sources, distinguishes facts from inference and uncertainty, evaluates alignment with the current brief and goals, and produces a durable recommendation. The evaluation can propose follow-up work or governed artifact changes, but no canonical brief, goal, design, directive, or implementation work is changed or created as approved work without the applicable policy and approval path.
